information:
This competition is a series competition with [Irvine Summer 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IrvineSummer2022/). Registrants will only be accepted to one competition. If you register for both, we will accept whichever registration was completed first, unless otherwise noted.

This competition is hosted by West Coast Cubing.
